front.title: Overlay Routable Crytographic Hash IDentifiers Version 3

abstract.t: Over time improvements and implementation considerations have been accumulating around Overlay Routable Cryptographic Hash Identifiers (ORCHIDs) for the Host Identity Protocol (HIP) and the Drone Remote Identification Protocol (DRIP). Such improvements like the addition of hierarchy in RFC9374, or the development of using ORCHIDs in other frameworks are scattered across resources. This document serves to combine lessons learned and minor corrections into a single specification that obsolete RFC7343 and updates RFC7401 and RFC9374 to maintain interoperability of ORCHID-aware implementations.
